rows.ref: HE HOPED THERE WOULD BE STEW FOR DINNER TURNIPS AND CARROTS AND BRUISED POTATOES AND FAT MUTTON PIECES TO BE LADLED OUT IN THICK PEPPERED FLOUR FATTENED SAUCE
rows.hyp: He hoped there would be stew for dinner, turnips and carrots and bruised potatoes and fat mutton pieces to be ladled out in thick peppered flower fattened sauce.

rows.ref: STUFF IT INTO YOU HIS BELLY COUNSELLED HIM
rows.hyp: Stuff it into you, his belly counseled him.

rows.ref: AFTER EARLY NIGHTFALL THE YELLOW LAMPS WOULD LIGHT UP HERE AND THERE THE SQUALID QUARTER OF THE BROTHELS
rows.hyp: After early nightfall, the yellow lamps would light up here and there the squalid quarter of the brothels.

rows.ref: HELLO BERTIE ANY GOOD IN YOUR MIND
rows.hyp: How, Bertie, any good in your mind?

rows.ref: NUMBER TEN FRESH NELLY IS WAITING ON YOU GOOD NIGHT HUSBAND
rows.hyp: Number ten, fresh Nelly is waiting on you. Good night, husband.

rows.ref: THE MUSIC CAME NEARER AND HE RECALLED THE WORDS THE WORDS OF SHELLEY'S FRAGMENT UPON THE MOON WANDERING COMPANIONLESS PALE FOR WEARINESS
rows.hyp: The music came nearer, and he recalled the words, the words of Shelley's fragment upon the moon, wandering companionless, pale for weariness.

rows.ref: THE DULL LIGHT FELL MORE FAINTLY UPON THE PAGE WHEREON ANOTHER EQUATION BEGAN TO UNFOLD ITSELF SLOWLY AND TO SPREAD ABROAD ITS WIDENING TAIL
rows.hyp: The dull light fell more faintly upon the page, whereon another equation began to unfold itself slowly, and to spread abroad its widening tail.

rows.ref: A COLD LUCID INDIFFERENCE REIGNED IN HIS SOUL
rows.hyp: A cold lucid indifference reigned in his soul.

rows.ref: THE CHAOS IN WHICH HIS ARDOUR EXTINGUISHED ITSELF WAS A COLD INDIFFERENT KNOWLEDGE OF HIMSELF
rows.hyp: The chaos in which his ardor extinguished itself was a cold, indifferent knowledge of himself.

rows.ref: AT MOST BY AN ALMS GIVEN TO A BEGGAR WHOSE BLESSING HE FLED FROM HE MIGHT HOPE WEARILY TO WIN FOR HIMSELF SOME MEASURE OF ACTUAL GRACE
rows.hyp: At most, by an alms given to a beggar whose blessing he fled from, he might hope wearily to win for himself some measure of actual grace.
